classic_meaning: Divide an object into independent parts; make it sectional; increase its degree of fragmentation
software_analogue: Microservices, sharding, code splitting, modular permissions per record
provocation_prompt: What if this were split into parts that can each be replaced alone?

classic_meaning: Extract the disturbing part or property; or extract only the necessary part
software_analogue: Pull the hot path out of the monolith; extract the one noisy feature into its own service
provocation_prompt: What single part causes most of the trouble, and what if it lived elsewhere?

classic_meaning: Change structure from uniform to non-uniform; let each part serve a different condition
software_analogue: Tiered storage, per-branch permissions, different UX for elders vs youth
provocation_prompt: Why is every part treated identically when the parts are not identical?

classic_meaning: Replace symmetry with asymmetry; increase the degree of asymmetry
software_analogue: Read replicas vs write primary, asymmetric approval rights, one-way sync
provocation_prompt: What if the two sides were deliberately unequal?

classic_meaning: Bring identical or adjacent objects together; make operations parallel or contiguous
software_analogue: Batching, bulk endpoints, combining review queues, one event for many notifications
provocation_prompt: What things are handled one at a time that could be handled as a set?

classic_meaning: Make an object perform multiple functions, eliminating the need for others
software_analogue: One data model that serves display, print and export; one identity that serves auth and lineage
provocation_prompt: Which two components could become one that does both jobs?

classic_meaning: Place one object inside another, and that inside a third
software_analogue: Nested trees, ltree paths, embedded documents, sub-branch inside branch inside clan
provocation_prompt: What if containment replaced linkage?

classic_meaning: Compensate an object's weight by merging it with something that provides lift
software_analogue: Offset a heavy feature by pairing it with something that makes it feel light — progressive disclosure, defaults
provocation_prompt: What could carry this weight for the user instead of the user carrying it?

classic_meaning: Pre-load a counter-stress before the harmful action occurs
software_analogue: Rate limits and validation before submit; pre-emptive conflict checks before a merge
provocation_prompt: What stress arrives later that could be pre-loaded against now?

classic_meaning: Perform the required change before it is needed; pre-arrange objects for instant action
software_analogue: Precompute, prefetch, pre-generate the reminder, pre-index the search corpus
provocation_prompt: What work happens at request time that could already be done?

classic_meaning: Prepare emergency means beforehand to compensate for low reliability
software_analogue: Backups, audit log, undo, draft state, soft delete, approval rollback
provocation_prompt: What is the emergency you have not prepared a cushion for?

classic_meaning: Change operating conditions so nothing needs to be raised or lowered
software_analogue: Remove the privilege escalation step entirely; same interface at every level
provocation_prompt: What step exists only to move something up or down a hierarchy?

classic_meaning: Invert the action; make movable parts fixed and fixed parts movable; turn it upside down
software_analogue: Push instead of pull; let contributors propose and elders approve rather than elders enter
provocation_prompt: What if the direction of the whole flow were reversed?

classic_meaning: Replace linear parts with curved; use rollers, spirals; go from linear to rotary motion
software_analogue: Cyclical processes instead of pipelines; recurring annual rhythm instead of one-shot launch
provocation_prompt: What if this were a cycle rather than a line with an end?

classic_meaning: Make characteristics adjustable to be optimal at each stage; divide rigid parts so they can move
software_analogue: Adaptive UI, configurable rules, feature flags, per-clan customization
provocation_prompt: What is fixed today that should adapt per context?

classic_meaning: If exactness is hard, do slightly less or slightly more — the problem may become easier
software_analogue: Approximate matching, draft-quality output for review, over-collect then filter
provocation_prompt: What becomes easy if you stop insisting on exactly right?

classic_meaning: Move to multi-storey or multi-dimensional arrangement; tilt or re-orient; use the other side
software_analogue: Add the time axis; add the geographic axis; render a tree as a fan or a map
provocation_prompt: What dimension is being ignored — time, place, generation, role?

classic_meaning: Oscillate; increase frequency; use resonance
software_analogue: Polling, periodic sweeps, recurring nudges, campaign cadence
provocation_prompt: What if this ran rhythmically instead of once?

classic_meaning: Replace continuous action with periodic or pulsing action; use pauses between pulses
software_analogue: Scheduled jobs instead of live listeners; quarterly campaigns instead of always-on nagging
provocation_prompt: What would be better as a pulse than as a constant?

classic_meaning: Work without idle intervals; eliminate all idle and intermittent operation
software_analogue: Background workers that never sit idle; make the quiet period do useful work
provocation_prompt: What resource is idle most of the time?

classic_meaning: Conduct a harmful or hazardous process at high speed
software_analogue: Do the painful migration in one fast cutover instead of a long dual-write
provocation_prompt: What pain shrinks if you go through it faster instead of gentler?

classic_meaning: Use a harmful factor to achieve a positive effect; amplify a harm until it stops being harmful
software_analogue: Turn data conflicts into verification tasks; turn rivalry between branches into a contribution leaderboard
provocation_prompt: What is currently a problem that could become the engine?

classic_meaning: Introduce feedback; if feedback exists, reverse or change its magnitude
software_analogue: Contribution scores, validation loops, showing the user the effect of their edit immediately
provocation_prompt: Where does the actor never learn the result of their action?

classic_meaning: Use an intermediary carrier or process; merge one object temporarily with another
software_analogue: Adapter layer, moderator role, staging table, a broker between contributor and record
provocation_prompt: Who or what should stand between these two that currently touch directly?

classic_meaning: Make the object serve and repair itself; make use of waste resources
software_analogue: Self-healing data, crowdsourced correction, users maintaining their own subtree
provocation_prompt: What maintenance could the system or its users do for themselves?

classic_meaning: Use a cheap copy instead of the fragile original; replace the object with optical copies
software_analogue: Scan the fragile original and work from the digital copy; use previews instead of full assets
provocation_prompt: What irreplaceable thing is being handled directly?

classic_meaning: Replace an expensive object with many cheap ones, forgoing some qualities
software_analogue: Disposable environments, throwaway prototypes, ephemeral share links
provocation_prompt: What if this were disposable instead of durable?

classic_meaning: Replace a mechanical means with sensory, field, or electronic means
software_analogue: Replace manual review with a rule engine; replace form entry with vision OCR or speech
provocation_prompt: What manual mechanism could be replaced by a different medium entirely?

classic_meaning: Use gas and liquid parts instead of solid ones
software_analogue: Elastic infrastructure, streaming rather than batch, fluid layouts
provocation_prompt: What rigid structure could become a flow?

classic_meaning: Use flexible shells and thin films instead of three-dimensional structures
software_analogue: Thin adapters, façade over legacy, a lightweight wrapper instead of a rewrite
provocation_prompt: What heavy structure could be a thin skin over what exists?

classic_meaning: Make an object porous or add porous elements; use pores to carry substances
software_analogue: Plugin points, extension hooks, optional fields that carry unforeseen data
provocation_prompt: Where should the system have holes on purpose?

classic_meaning: Change the color or transparency of an object or its environment
software_analogue: Visual state encoding, highlighting the path, opacity for uncertain data, colour-coded branches
provocation_prompt: What invisible state should become visible at a glance?

classic_meaning: Make interacting objects from the same material or with the same properties
software_analogue: One language end-to-end, shared types, one schema across import and export
provocation_prompt: What impedance mismatch exists because two parts are made of different stuff?

classic_meaning: Discard parts that have done their job; restore consumable parts during operation
software_analogue: Garbage collection, expiring caches, archiving completed tasks, regenerating derived data
provocation_prompt: What should disappear after use instead of accumulating?

classic_meaning: Change the physical state, concentration, flexibility, or temperature
software_analogue: Change granularity, change refresh rate, change from strict to eventual consistency
provocation_prompt: Which dial has never actually been turned?

classic_meaning: Use phenomena occurring during phase transitions — volume change, heat loss or absorption
software_analogue: Exploit the moment of change: onboarding, a death in the family, a new birth, an annual ceremony
provocation_prompt: What happens at the moment of transition that could be harnessed?

classic_meaning: Use thermal expansion or contraction of materials
software_analogue: Let the system expand under load and contract when quiet; seasonal capacity
provocation_prompt: What should grow and shrink with the season of use?

classic_meaning: Replace common air with enriched or oxygenated air
software_analogue: Enrich the context: give the model, or the person, richer surrounding information before they act
provocation_prompt: What decision is being made in a thin-information environment?

classic_meaning: Replace the normal environment with an inert one; add neutral parts or additives
software_analogue: Sandboxes, dry-run mode, staging, read-only demo of sensitive data
provocation_prompt: Where do you need a space in which mistakes cannot react?

classic_meaning: Replace homogeneous materials with composite ones
software_analogue: Hybrid retrieval (vector + keyword), rules plus LLM, human approval plus automation
provocation_prompt: What single-material solution should become a deliberate composite?
